__comment: Per-target DB credentials for the SQL v2 bridge (EXEXML/sql-v2.bat -> /opt/runsql.sh). Provide the REAL file at runtime as /opt/sql-bridge/targets.json (e.g. a Docker volume/bind mount); it is NOT baked into the image. The EXE/Script Advanced sensor's 'exeparams' is the key. 'sqlfile' is a file in Custom Sensors\sql\<flavor>\ (flavor derived from 'server'). Auth is SQL auth (dbauth=1).
